background: JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. is the main operating bank of JPMorgan Chase, the largest bank in the United States, serving consumers, businesses, corporates and institutions across the country and worldwide.
synthesis: All three main agencies rate the bank, AA on average with the weakest at AA-, all on a stable outlook; the last move was a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 15 Nov 2024. Capital is strong, with CET1 of 15.0% and Tier 1 leverage of 7.5% both in the top quarter of US banks. Since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.5 points while Tier 1 leverage has held steady (figures to 30 Jun 2026), and no rating action has been taken in the last 90 days.
